essays.text: Compose a brief resolution of the United Nations Educational, Scientific andCultural Organization (UNESCO) that urges the United Nations SecurityCouncil to invite UNESCO director-general to speak before the SecurityCouncil for the purpose of the protection of human heritage. (25%)

Draft an English description as to the history and value of the TaiwanFellowship provided by the R.O.C. Ministry of Foreign Affairs since2010/2011, as well as general application procedures for the year of 2024.(25%)

Government has managed andshould manage the issue of the R.O.C.’s “meaningful participation” in the caseof the World Health Assembly. (25%)

Government’s position to a foreign press whosenews report indicates that “Taiwan should not acquire more advancedweaponry systems from the United States in order for further stability in theIndo-Pacific region.” (25%)
